item.title: General Dynamics Electric Boat parent ends 2025 with $4.21B profit

item.title: R.I. unveils strategy to create an AI-proficient workforce statewide
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The Rhode Island AI Task Force on Wednesday released its multipronged strategy to help make the Ocean State a national leader in applied artificial intelligence by 2030.
